narr: A seasonably strong shortwave trough brought scattered severe storms to Massachusetts during the afternoon and evening. Persistent and redeveloping storms also lead to flooding issues.
ev: In Boston, on Columbia Rd at Hamilton St a car was stuck in flooding and the driver needed to be rescued.
In Dedham, the intersection of Milton and River St was flooded.
In West Springfield, River St was flooded.
In Quincy, I-93 North at exit 9 had the middle and right lanes flooded and impassable.
